title: The "Pixar" Jacket
description:
Background: "Say like this jacket I'm wearin right now.. took like.. a lotta ideas and we mix it together so it's almost like the Pixar of jackets... taking the ripstop... cause usually if you get a bomber they do it in this nylon but we're using biodegradable fabrics so everything had to be this dry fabric so it doesn't create landfills it just goes back into the Earth, and then we just kept working on the cut over and over and then just put the hoodie with it." - Ye regarding the "Pixar Jacket" during one of X17's visits to the Sweetgreen Offices/Yeezy atelier at the time.

Easily the most famous piece from the whole SZNX V1 era, the Pixar Jacket is a culmination of various ideas explored in late 2022 -- ripstop construction and hood incorporation, namely.

The ripstop fabric was a cheap fabric bought in Los Angeles, just down the street from the Sweetgreen Office. It was not biodegradable yet.

This version was given to an X17 Employee during a visit to the Sweetgreen Offices in LA.
